features.title: Wooden facia for aesthetic appeal
features.text: The Celestial sofa’s decorative wooden accents along the base add a warm, natural contrast to the sleek upholstery. This thoughtful detail introduces visual depth and elevates the sofa's overall design beyond basic single-seater styles.

features.title: Symmetrical stitching lines
features.text: Neat, precise stitching across the upholstery creates visual refinement and emphasises quality craftsmanship. This meticulous detailing adds sophistication and makes the piece feel premium and thoughtfully constructed.

features.title: Pocket spring seat for bounciness
features.text: Embedded pocket springs within the soft foam seat create a buoyant, responsive feel that adapts to your body's movements. This combination delivers a soft, sinking sensation with gentle bounce, transforming ordinary sitting into a luxuriously comfortable experience.

features.title: High-back body with lumbar support
features.text: Tall backrest filled with recron fibre cradles your entire body from shoulders to head, creating comprehensive support. Moreover, enhanced lumbar contouring follows the natural curve of your lower back, providing targeted support where you need it most.

features.title: Angular padded armrests
features.text: Contoured armrests position your arms at ergonomically optimal heights for a natural, relaxed posture. The angled design accommodates different arm placements, whether you're reading, working on a laptop, or simply settling in for conversation.

features.title: Elevated pvc legs for easy cleaning
features.text: Sturdy PVC legs lift the sofa off the floor, creating clearance for easy vacuuming and sweeping underneath. This practical elevation keeps your living space clean without requiring constant furniture rearranging during routine maintenance.
